contexts.statement: Review the existing Family 029 Argus arguments against the read-only inventory, separating supplied-data algebra, representation/arithmetic hypotheses, conditional global reflection, and unexamined manuscript context.

definitions.q: Exterior residue cardinality; q is a prime power congruent to 1 modulo 12.
definitions.chi: A residue-field character of exact order 6, extended by zero even at exponent zero.
definitions.scope: Exploratory old-draft review, not a new error search or unconditional certification of either manuscript.
definitions.source_status: The supplied 2026-11-06 snapshot manifest covers five core artifacts only. Primary literature texts are already present except the Neukirch textbook pages; retrieval HTML is not that book. Current citation attribution awaits a distinct reader and native acceptance.

claims.natural_statement: For the declared conductor-zero Jacquet shell rules, lifts, exact order-six residue character and nontrivial additive character, the supplied local data imply the all-nonnegative-valuation shell formulas, triple-step recurrence and masked Weyl exponents stated in REPORT.md Section 2; the q=13 exact calculation is a separate finite diagnostic, not their universal proof.

The old cover, exceptional-datum, factorization and radial smoothing argument must be assessed conditionally on the exact imported representation and arithmetic propositions below; it does not follow from the supplied local algebra alone.

external_assumptions.statement: The determinant-modified cover has the torus cocycle, center and tame compact splitting needed for the rank-two, degree-three, c=2 scalar quotient.
external_assumptions.source: Kazhdan and Patterson, Metaplectic forms (1984). Existing kp1984.txt and page images are present; applicability and current independent attribution are not inferred from retrieval.
external_assumptions.locator: Section 0.1, Propositions 0.1.1 (p.42) and 0.1.3 (p.44)

external_assumptions.statement: A compatible exceptional unramified datum has the irreducible quotient and Weyl-conjugate subrepresentation with the stated tame spherical vector.
external_assumptions.source: Kazhdan and Patterson, Metaplectic forms (1984); primary text already obtained.
external_assumptions.locator: Theorem I.2.9(a),(b),(f), p.72

external_assumptions.statement: The rank-two, degree-three, c=2 exceptional Whittaker space is one-dimensional under the exact printed uniqueness criterion.
external_assumptions.source: Kazhdan and Patterson, Metaplectic forms (1984); retained p.79 image is required to resolve the OCR congruence sign.
external_assumptions.locator: Corollary I.3.6, p.79

external_assumptions.statement: The globally compatible exceptional inducing datum yields a residual automorphic representation with nonzero global Whittaker functional and the stated tame local uniqueness.
external_assumptions.source: Kazhdan and Patterson, Metaplectic forms (1984); primary text already obtained.
external_assumptions.locator: Theorems II.2.1 (p.118) and II.2.5(a),(b) (p.122), with the compatibility condition on p.107

external_assumptions.statement: At complex places the exceptional representation has the stated ordinary principal-series model and Whittaker uniqueness.
external_assumptions.source: Kazhdan and Patterson, Metaplectic forms (1984); primary text already obtained.
external_assumptions.locator: Theorems I.6.4(c) (p.104) and I.6.5(c) (p.105)

external_assumptions.statement: The global finite-S normalization uses C_S T(S), with the corresponding T(S)^(-1) factors, rather than the uncorrected stabilization; the withdrawn auxiliary vanishing assertion is not available.
external_assumptions.source: Kazhdan and Patterson, Corrections to Metaplectic forms (1985); complete correction text already obtained.
external_assumptions.locator: p.203, corrections to Theorems II.2.2-II.2.3 and p.130

external_assumptions.statement: The Eisenstein constant term is the Weyl sum of factored local intertwining operators and continues meromorphically to the exceptional residue.
external_assumptions.source: Kazhdan and Patterson, Metaplectic forms (1984); primary text already obtained.
external_assumptions.locator: Proposition II.1.2 and Theorem II.1.3, pp.110-111

external_assumptions.statement: The declared S-unit Lagrangian complement, balanced generators and reciprocity conventions require local Hilbert duality and power-class dimensions, the S-unit theorem, the S-class-field description of unramified extensions split at S, Hilbert reciprocity, and norm-one idele-class compactness.
external_assumptions.source: Neukirch, Algebraic Number Theory (1999), cited in the old arithmetic section at II Corollary (5.8), I (11.6)-(11.7), V Proposition (3.2), VI Theorems (1.6),(7.3),(8.1) and Proposition (6.9). Only a publisher HTML book page was retrieved; these textbook pages were not obtained. This is intentionally a source-only, uncited assumption, not a checked canonical citation.

external_assumptions.statement: For a number field and an adelic additive character trivial on it, self-duality and Poisson summation apply with self-dual measures, after non-self-dual exterior lattices enter S.
external_assumptions.source: Weil, Sur certains groupes d'operateurs unitaires (1964); the legitimate scan text is present, unlike the failed initial retrieval response.
external_assumptions.locator: Chapter II Section 29; Chapter III Section 41 equation (39)

external_assumptions.statement: Quadratic Weil indices have the Hilbert-symbol multiplicative defect and the global product formula, in characteristic zero and with the declared odd conductor-zero exterior normalization.
external_assumptions.source: Weil, Sur certains groupes d'operateurs unitaires (1964); primary scan text already obtained.
external_assumptions.locator: Chapter II Sections 27-28 and Section 30 Proposition 5

external_assumptions.statement: If two finite-field multiplicative characters and their product are nontrivial, norm lifting through degree f sends their Jacobi sum to (-1)^(f-1) times its f-th power; the declared application uses rho,rho,rho^2 of order three.
external_assumptions.source: Hoshi and Kanai, Davenport-Hasse theorem for polynomial Gauss sums over finite fields (2021), version 2; primary text already obtained.
external_assumptions.locator: Theorem 1.1, p.2

claims.natural_statement: For fixed cyclotomic F containing mu_12, final fixed S, the declared balanced annular rows and arithmetic/representation inputs, determine whether REPORT.md Sections 3-5 justify sum_m |B_m(Z)|^2 << Z^epsilon P^(1/2)(D+D^2 P/Z) uniformly for dyadic P,D>=1 and Z>=2, retaining shared primes, powerful rows, unrestricted cubes, and every nonunit mask.

external_assumptions.statement: A full quadratic Hecke family satisfying every part of Definition 1 has the (M+N)(MN)^epsilon large sieve for squarefree ideal rows and columns; applicability requires the exact conductor product condition, not just quadratic reciprocity.
external_assumptions.source: Goldmakher and Louvel, A quadratic large sieve inequality over number fields, arXiv version 2; the obtained primary text supersedes an inaccurate search paraphrase of condition (3).
external_assumptions.locator: Definition 1 and Theorem 1.1, pp.1-2, with the primitive-product convention on p.5

external_assumptions.statement: Agreement at finitely many primes and valuation cutoffs does not establish an all-Z, all-valuation reflection moment.
external_assumptions.source: Old MATH_STATE.json route R_FINITE_SAMPLES_ONLY, explicitly retired for this reason; REPORT.md Sections 2 and 6 distinguish the general supplied-data argument from the F_13 diagnostic.

external_assumptions.statement: A rational element of a number field containing mu_3 which is a cube at every completion is a global cube: otherwise the nontrivial cyclic Kummer extension has a nonsplit unramified prime. This is the standard Kummer/Chebotarev consequence used to check the global inducing character.
external_assumptions.source: Standard Kummer theory and Chebotarev theorem, as explicitly invoked in primary manuscript 10-whittaker-calculation.tex lines 61-74. No separate canonical theorem citation was supplied; retain this as a source-only assumption.
